purpose: Document city-local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Yantai government material identifies a Fushan branch of the city real-estate registration center and Fushan district notices document current registration activity. Yantai also documents public cadastral-map lookup by location or parcel code through its service channels, but its online public-query channel requires real-name WeChat registration. No anonymous full-polygon service is established. The published Yantai cadastral-map lookup is an individual property inquiry through registered WeChat/one-network channels, using a known location or parcel identifier. No public geometry-only schema or anonymous WFS/GeoJSON endpoint was found. No account was created and no parcel-specific query was submitted.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Yantai municipal notice lists the Fushan branch of the city real-estate registration center at the Fushan district service center.

Official Yantai natural-resources notice says nonprivate cadastral-map data may be queried by anyone using property location or code through its official channels, including cadastral subdistrict, use, area and other land attributes.

Official Yantai government instructions describe Fushan as an available area for public information inquiry and state that the WeChat workflow requires real-name registration and a known location, unit number or certificate number.

Official Fushan district government registration notice confirms current local real-estate registration activity. The notice includes personal/property-level information; no such values were copied or retained.
